q: How do we explain Scope 1, 2 and 3 to our staff in Hindi?
title: Carbon terms explained in Hindi
short: Keep it to what staff handle. Scope 1 is ईंधन जो हम खुद जलाते हैं (fuel we burn ourselves), Scope 2 is खरीदी गई बिजली (electricity we buy), and Scope 3 is बाकी सप्लाई चेन (the rest of the supply chain). Tie each term to a bill they already file.
audience: Owners training accounts and stores staff

ul: Scope 1: डीज़ल, पेट्रोल, LPG, कोयला जो हमारी मशीनों में जलता है.
Scope 3: खरीदा गया माल, ढुलाई, कर्मचारियों का आना जाना.
उत्सर्जन कारक (emission factor): हर लीटर या यूनिट पर कितना CO2.

sections.h: Link each term to a document
p: Diesel bills for Scope 1, the electricity bill for Scope 2, purchase and freight invoices for Scope 3. Staff then know what to keep.

senseible: Senseible keeps every bill, invoice and calculation in one dated, fingerprinted record, so the evidence behind each figure can be found again by anyone who checks it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
